description: Full Base token verdict for a token contract address. Pulls free public onchain data (Base RPC, DexScreener, GoPlus token security) and runs 10 weighted checks: contract code present, honeypot / cannot-sell flags, mintable supply and hidden owner, owner control surface (proxy, pausable transfers, modifiable taxes, ownership take-back, self-destruct), buy/sell taxes, holder concentration (top-10 share), liquidity depth across Base DEX pairs, liquidity locked/burned share, 24h trading activity, and token age. Returns machine-readable JSON LED BY A FAIL-CLOSED TRADE DECISION — GO / HOLD / BLOCK — plus a one-line plain-language verdict, a 0-100 score, an A-F grade, a risk level, the top flags, per-check pass/partial/fail/unknown with evidence, a token block (name, symbol, supply, holder count), a market block (price, liquidity, 24h volume/txns, main pair, age), the decision basis, and a per-source status map. FAIL-CLOSED: if any key data source fails or returns nothing, the decision can never be GO; if two or more fail, it is BLOCK. HONEST LIMITS: a point-in-time snapshot — liquidity, holders, and flags can change within minutes on young tokens; checks that cannot be evaluated return unknown, never guesses; this is a mechanical risk scan, not financial advice. Cost: $0.02 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this as a pre-trade screen before buying or quoting any Base token.

address.description: Base token contract address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars), e.g. 0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed
